# PageDescriptor

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Describes a page's configuration and structure. Provides scoped methods for page size, margins, headers, content, and footers.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PageDescriptor()
```

## Methods

- [`Background`](#background): Returns a container for the full-page background slot.
- [`Content`](#content): Returns a container for the main page content.
- [`DefaultTextStyle`](#defaulttextstyle): Configures the default text style for all text on this page.
- [`Footer`](#footer): Returns a container for the page footer.
- [`Foreground`](#foreground): Returns a container for the full-page foreground slot.
- [`Header`](#header): Returns a container for the page header.
- [`Margin`](#margin): Sets the page margin in points.
- [`Orientation`](#orientation): Sets the page orientation.
- [`Size`](#size): Sets the page size.

### `Background`

```csharp
IContentContainer Background()
```

Returns a container for the full-page background slot. Content placed here is painted behind everything else and spans the entire page, ignoring the margins - ideal for letterhead, certificate backgrounds, and bleed images.

### `Content`

```csharp
IContentContainer Content()
```

Returns a container for the main page content. This is where the bulk of the document content goes.

### `DefaultTextStyle`

```csharp
void DefaultTextStyle(Action<TextStyle> configure)
```

Configures the default text style for all text on this page. Overrides any document-level default set via `WithDefaultTextStyle`. Text elements created after this call will inherit these defaults.

### `Footer`

```csharp
IContentContainer Footer()
```

Returns a container for the page footer. Content placed here appears at the bottom of every page.

### `Foreground`

```csharp
IContentContainer Foreground()
```

Returns a container for the full-page foreground slot. Content placed here is painted on top of everything else and spans the entire page, ignoring the margins - ideal for "DRAFT"/"CONFIDENTIAL" overlays and stamps.

### `Header`

```csharp
IContentContainer Header()
```

Returns a container for the page header. Content placed here appears at the top of every page.

### `Margin`

```csharp
void Margin(float margin)
void Margin(Thickness margins)
```

Sets the page margin in points.

### `Orientation`

```csharp
void Orientation(PageOrientation orientation)
```

Sets the page orientation.

### `Size`

```csharp
void Size(PdfSize size)
void Size(PdfSize size, bool preserveDimensions)
```

Sets the page size.
